Package neqsim.process.equipment.network

Class NetworkHydraulicModelComparison

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.network.NetworkHydraulicModelComparison
public final class NetworkHydraulicModelComparison extends Object
Compare Beggs-Brill and two-fluid hydraulics on detached copies of one field topology.

The comparison changes only the requested pipe edges. All other edge models, typed field identities, geometry, boundary conditions and explicitly assigned node fluids are replayed from the same canonical FieldNetworkTopology. The caller's topology is never executed or mutated. This permits mixed-fidelity qualification without rebuilding a field definition.

Profile pressures are normalized to Pa, temperatures to K and velocities to m/s. Phase velocities are superficial: Beggs-Brill supplies these directly, while two-fluid phase velocities are multiplied by their solved phase area fractions.

1.0
Author:

  • Method Details

    • compare

      public NetworkHydraulicModelComparison.Result compare(List<String> edgeIds, UUID id)
      Compare selected pipe edges using Beggs-Brill and two-fluid hydraulics.

      Other pipe edges retain their configured hydraulic models in both solves. Both complete networks must converge and every selected edge must report its requested model as converged; fallback or stale profile evidence is rejected.

      Parameters:
      edgeIds - canonical pipe edge identifiers
      id - calculation identifier applied to both detached solves
      Returns:
      immutable comparison and initialization evidence

    • compareMeshSensitivity

      public NetworkHydraulicModelComparison.MeshSensitivityResult compareMeshSensitivity(List<String> edgeIds, List<Integer> segmentCounts, UUID id)
      Compare selected edges at several discretizations without mutating the caller topology.

      Every requested count is applied to every selected edge on a detached topology before the normal fail-closed Beggs-Brill/two-fluid comparison is executed. Unselected edge meshes and hydraulic models remain unchanged.

      Parameters:
      edgeIds - canonical pipe edge identifiers
      segmentCounts - distinct segment counts, each at least two
      id - calculation identifier applied to the detached solves
      Returns:
      immutable comparison results keyed by segment count
